trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: يَا اللهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا رَبِّ يَا اللهُ يَا مُهَيْمِنُ يَا اللهُ يَا رَبِّ يَا مُتَكَبِّرُ يَا اللهُ يَا رَبِّ يَا مُتَعَالِيْ يَا اللهُ يَا رَبِّ يَا مُفِيْدُ (مُعِيْدُ) يَا اللهُ يَا رَبِّ يَا ذَا الطَّوْلِ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ يَا اللهُ يَا رَبِّ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ يَا اللهُ يَا رَبِّ يَا مَنْ اَظْهَرَ الْجَمِيْلَ وَسَتَرَ الْقَبِيْحَ يَا مَنْ لَنْ يُّؤَاخِذَ بِالْجَرِيْرَةِ وَلَمْ يَهْتِكِ السِّتْرَ يَا كَرِيْمَ الْعَفْوِ يَا حَسَنَ التَّجَاوُزِ يَا وَاسِعَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ يَا بَاسِطَ الْيَدَيْنِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ يَا خَلِيْلَ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَنَجِيَّ مُوْسٰى وَمُصْطَفِيَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهٖ وَاَعْتِقْنِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ فِيْ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانٍ صُمْتُهٗ لَكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: YAA ALLAAHO YAA RAHMAANO YAA RABBE YAA ALLAAHO YAA MOHAIY-MENO YAA ALLAAHO YAA RABBE YAA MOTA-KABBERO YAA ALLAAHO YAA RABBE YAA MOTA-A’A-LEE YAA ALLAAHO YAA RABBE YAA MOFEE-DO (MO-E’E-DO) YAA ALLAAHO YAA RABBE YAA ZAT-TAWLE LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA YAA ALLAAHO YAA RABBE YAA ZAL-JALAALE WAL-IKRAA-ME YAA ALLAAHO YAA RABBE YAA MAN AZ-HARAL JAMEELA WA SATARAL QABEEHA YAA MAN LAN YO-AAKHE-ZA BIL-JAREE-RATE WA LAM YAHTE-KIS SITRA YAA KAREE-MAL A’FWE YAA HASANAT TAJAA-WOZE YAA WAASE-A’L MAGH-FE-RATE YAA BAASE-TAL YA-DAIY-NE BIR RAH-MATE YAA KHALEELA IBRAA-HIMA WA NAJJE-YA MOOSAA WA MUSTA-FEYA MOHAMMADIN SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE-HI WA A’TIQ-NEE MENAN NAARE FEE HAA-ZASH SHAH-RIL A’ZEEME WA LAA TAJ-A’L-HO AAKHE-RA SHAHRE RAMAZAA-NIN SUMTO-HU LAKA YAA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEENA.

trans.en: O God! O Compassionate! O Lord! O God! O Guardian! O God! O Lord! O Proud! O God! O Lord! O Most Exalted! O God! O Lord! O Reproducer! O God! O Lord! O Lord of Bestowals! He who is Benevolent. There is no God but You. O God! O Lord of Majesty, Bounty and Honor! O God! O Lord! O He who reveals the beauties and hides the ugliness! O He who is does not take revenge for misdeeds and does not divulge secrets! O Generous one who Pardons! O He who overlooks faults! O Vast Forgiver! O Extender of both hands with mercy! O Friend of Abraham (a.s)! O Savior of Moses (a.s)! O Chooser of Muhammad (s.a.w.a)! O my God! Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s) and save me from the Fire in this grand month. Please do not make this the last month of Ramadhan in which I fast for You. O the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
